traceability.notes: The story 003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS defines coordinated ESLint rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation that enforce @story and @req annotations consistently across a shared set of function-like constructs, with configurable scope/exportPriority, robust JSDoc parsing, TypeScript support, and clear error reporting. The implementation matches these requirements: the two rule modules and their shared helpers are present; dedicated tests tagged to this story and its requirement IDs comprehensively cover function detection (including TSDeclareFunction and TSMethodSignature), JSDoc/comment parsing, required annotations, configurable scope and exportPriority behavior, error locations, and TypeScript-specific scenarios. All such tests are currently green in the full Jest run. Documentation for both rules exists under docs/rules, and integration tests confirm the rules are wired into ESLint configs and CLI flows. Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in this story are fully satisfied.
